scientific_truth_rules.net_reduction_requires: Comparable documented operational energy-boundary WTW CO2e OR explicitly conditional transparent source-specific accounting, not claimed actual net reduction
scientific_truth_rules.time_and_service: same all-task denominator for completion/ontime; matched time paired with full denominator status
scientific_truth_rules.mode: only 5 primary modes; EXP05~10 diagnostics and scenarios
scientific_truth_rules.sample: distinct seed uncertainty and independent day/weather blocks
scientific_truth_rules.airspace: simulation conditional screening != regulatory flight authorisation
scientific_truth_rules.data: raw source provenance and hashes; never invent GIS, orders, fuel, wind, grid EF

required_packages: one independent ZIP per V2-S06 through S12 containing source/inputs/code/results/tests/hashes/README; nonexisting real inputs reported HOLD
